plansHeading: Start free. Scale when you need it.
plansLede: AGI charges nothing for Local or BYOK. Run models on your own hardware or bring your own provider keys on Desktop and CLI. Managed cloud is open in public alpha; higher-capacity paid plans are rolling out as metering, refunds, and provider terms are proven.
localTierBody: Run Ollama or LM Studio offline on your laptop. No keys, no quotas, no internet.
byokTierBody: Bring your own keys to supported cloud providers. Provider billing and data handling are route-specific.
byokFeature3: Visible provider label on every route
hobbyTierBody: Try AGI in the browser with Auto Economy routing. Free hosted usage is intentionally small so the demo stays sustainable.
hobbyFeature4: Higher hosted capacity on paid plans
managedWaitlistNote: Higher hosted capacity rolls out through the plans below.

Leave your details for early access to higher-capacity plans, team seats, and AGI-managed provider compute as usage ledgering, abuse controls, retention, and provider-cost controls roll out.
